text:
Alex: Quick idea — propose we add a small, orthogonal "exit_code" taxonomy for degraded routing cases so clients + console can reason about partial failures without changing HTTP semantics.

Maria: Can you give a concrete example of when this would be used vs an explicit 5xx/429? Want to avoid new confusion for customers.

Alex: Sure. Examples:
- DEGRADED_THROTTLE: we return tokens but with lower throughput (queueing/burst applied)
- DEGRADED_MODEL_FALLBACK: fallback to smaller model variant to satisfy latency SLO
- DEGRADED_REGION_FALLBACK: routed to secondary region (higher latency but still returns)

Sam: Nice. So status stays 200 when we return output, 429/5xx when we fail entirely. The exit_code would be surfaced in a header and console badge?

Alex: Exactly. Proposal: keep HTTP semantics, add `X-Redwood-Exit` header and `x_redwood.exit_code` telemetry tag. Console shows a small badge: "Degraded — partial output" with hover text that maps to the exit_code and an explanation.

Nina: For SDKs we should translate to friendly enums, not force users to parse headers. E.g., `response.exitCode === 'DEGRADED_MODEL_FALLBACK'`.

Maria: We also need clear client-facing copy. "Degraded — partial output" might alarm users. Maybe: "Reduced fidelity to maintain latency" ?

Alex: Good call. Proposed badge copy: "Reduced fidelity to meet latency" and secondary help text: "This request used a lower-cost model or reroute to preserve latency; output may be less detailed. See docs for fallback behavior."

Sam: Telemetry: counter `redwood.exit.degraded` with tag `exit_code`, plus `latency_delta_ms` histogram. That lets us correlate quality drop vs cost savings.

Nina: Rollout plan: feature flag `exit_code_header` off by default. Enable in canary (10% customers) + UI flag to surface badges. Console should only show badge when flag enabled for tenant.

Alex: Implementation notes:
```json
{
  "http_status": 200,
  "x_redwood": {
    "exit_code": "DEGRADED_MODEL_FALLBACK",
    "fallback_model": "redwood-mini-1",
    "reason": "latency_slo"
  }
}
```
This will be emitted by the routing layer.

Maria: Docs need a table mapping exit_code -> user-facing phrasing -> recommended retry/backoff behavior. E.g., DEGRADED_THROTTLE -> "Try again; you may be queued".

Sam: Also add an SDK helper `isDegraded(response)` and telemetry events so customers can alert on degradations.

Nina: Security/PII note: ensure we don't surface variant model names for private clusters unless tenant allows.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Alex pushed branch "exit-code-badging" to eng-platform, CI started.

Alex: I'll draft an RFC + console mockups by EOD. Action: I'll open RFC, Sam will add telemetry counters, Nina will prepare rollout flags, Maria will draft user copy.

Maria: +1, thanks. Small follow-up — include exact header name in SDK compatibility matrix.

Sam: I'll add a unit test that asserts header present on fallback paths.

Alex: Thanks everyone — we'll sync in next standup if anything blocks.
